messages.text: Correction for Lantern: production publishes on Thursdays, not Fridays. Keep Thursday as the release day.
I updated the release branch and the current build is 80 percent complete.
For Lantern, we decided to publish complete index snapshots instead of deltas so mirrors can recover after missing an update.
Maybe we'll move the mirrors to a different region next quarter.

existingMemory.title: Production release day
existingMemory.body: Lantern publishes production releases on Fridays.

The move is a possibility without a decision.
